## Fixed

- Update taskbar window titles promptly during repeated browser tab changes and ChatGPT chat navigation. Remove the inherited caption-freezing policy that could keep an old title or the intermediate application name visible for up to two seconds after the current title had already been received.
- Keep existing button identity, window order, grouping, single-line captions and Accessibility labels while showing the latest accepted title. No extra polling, dependencies or permissions are added.

## Verification

Regression tests reproduce the stale native caption on the previous implementation and pass after the fix. The complete test suite, a separate constrained Swift executor run, tooling, localization, deployment checks, WindowLab replay and Apple Silicon packaging pass in CI. Independent review found no actionable issues in the corrected scope.
